title: fix(console): a served form row marked required holds Save when left empty
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao7dmZQQ1tpabFMJS1Pf1uTi)_

Fixes #28179

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：元数据新建/编辑页现在认服务端表单行上的 `required: true`：这类行留空时，该字段下显示「This field is required.」，点保存不发请求；适用于所有元数据类型，不是权限集特例。
- 为什么改：#28152 之后新建权限集的「Label」带必填星号，但 `PermissionSetSchema.label` 仍是可选，页面只按 Zod 校验、服务端也接受，所以留空照样保存成功，星号只是装饰。
- 风险与回滚：只拦表单当前提供且可编辑的行（隐藏、只读、谓词隐藏的行不算），作者总能填上解锁；schema 自己要求的字段维持原判定，服务端接受集不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`（`requiredRowIssues` 与 `doSave` 中紧随 Name 拦截的那段），`SchemaForm.tsx`（`SectionedSchemaForm` 的 `visibleFields` / `requiredRowKey`），`ResourceEditPage.requiredRow-28179.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.requiredRow-28179.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿；或在 Console 设置 › 权限集 › 新建，只填 Name 点保存，Label 下出现必填提示且没有保存。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`SchemaForm`** gains an optional `onRequiredRowFieldsChange(fields)` prop. `SectionedSchemaForm` reports the top-level rows it offers whose served row says `required: true`: in a visible section (collapsed sections and other tabs count), not hidden, with a schema property, and editable (not `readonly`, not `immutable` outside create, not a read-only form). The row visibility filter is now one local function (`visibleFields`) that the rendered rows, the tab list and this report all read, so the hold and what is on screen cannot disagree. The callback is keyed on the joined field names, never on an array identity, and reports an empty set on unmount. Any non-sectioned face reports nothing.
- **`ResourceEditPage`** keeps those fields beside the existing `inlineIssueFields` state and derives `requiredRowIssues` from the draft: a reported field that is empty (absent, null, blank string, empty array) is a located issue with the new `engine.validation.fieldRequired` message. It is skipped where the served schema already requires the field (that field keeps its own verdict) or gives it a default. The issues join `displayIssues`, and `doSave` returns before any request while one stands, right after the existing Name hold, on create and on edit.
- **i18n**: `engine.validation.fieldRequired` in the studio `en` and `zh` packs (the only two the namespace ships), one block each.

## Why

A served form row's `required` is a layout override (`FormFieldSchema.required`, "Required override"). PR #28152 made the permission set's Label row required while `PermissionSetSchema.label` stays `z.string().optional()`, so the live Zod pass, the save-time checks and the server all accepted an empty Label: the star was the only thing that said otherwise.

Why this predicted verdict may hold Save when the live Zod pass may not: the advisory ruling at `blockingReport` guards against a client stricter than the server dead-bolting a draft the author cannot fix. Only rows the form on screen offers and lets the author edit report, so the author can always fill what holds the save, the same bound the Name hold (#27865) relies on.

## Tests

- `ResourceEditPage.requiredRow-28179.test.tsx` (real page, real `MetadataClient` over an in-memory server, real served form from `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY.permission`):
  - (a) New Permission Set, Label empty, Name `sales_ops`, Save: the inline issue is on the Label row and nowhere else, no `PUT` leaves; typing a Label clears it and Save sends `{ name: 'sales_ops', label: 'Sales Ops' }`.
  - (b) CONTROL: the same served form with the Label row's `required` removed: an empty Label saves.
  - (c) a served schema that requires `label`: the page gives the verdict it gave before (the create seed's placeholder refusal, objectui#12810), and the new message is not added.
- `SchemaForm.requiredRows-28179.test.tsx`: which rows are reported: an offered required row (also in a collapsed section); a predicate-hidden row only once its predicate shows it; `readonly`, `immutable` outside create and a read-only form are left out; a host-hidden row is left out; the flat fallback reports nothing; unmount reports an empty set.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured first (order step 1), as the page test on current `main` (`6285203d`): with the served permission form, the Label row draws the star and no issue appears after Save (reverse leg below). The page on `main` never reads a row's `required` outside the star, so Save takes the same path as CONTROL (b): the `PUT` goes out with no `label` and the page lands. The server accepting it follows from `PermissionSetSchema.label` being optional; not measured live against a running server.
- Zod-required rows behave as before by design: the rule only adds a verdict where the row is stricter than the served schema. A field both require keeps one message (the schema's) and the old refusal path.
- A required row in an inactive tab draws its issue only when its tab is mounted; until then it is named through the existing summary banner, which leaves out only fields drawn inline. Not separately pinned.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 (docs): no README or `content/docs/frontend/` page describes the metadata editor's save checks, so no doc page changed.
- The order placed the client-validation region at about L940 to L970; that range is the advisory-ruling comment. The hold sits in `doSave` beside the #27865 Name hold, as the claim's file surface records. No line in #28239's regions (import block, references code, item-tool sheets) changed.
